options.name: group
options.description: Group number to identify the Aggregate interface

options.name: hash_mode
options.description: -Hash mode  for the agg group. some mode cannot config use netconfig,like 'flexible' and 'per-packet'.

options.name: lacp_edge
options.description: Determine if an LACP agg group should be an edge aggregate interface

options.name: lacp_mode
options.description: If mode is set to LACP, the type operating mode can be selected. This  mode will then be set for all members in the group.

options.name: max_ports
options.description: Maximum number of selected ports for the agg group

options.name: members
options.description: COMPLETE Interface List that should be in the agg group. Full names should be used AND Interface names ARE case sensitive. For example, FortyGigE1/0/1 should NOT be written as fortygige1/0/1.  This is for safety.

options.name: min_ports
options.description: Minimum number of selected ports for the agg group

options.name: mode
options.description: Mode of the Aggregate interface.If you want to Configure the port rate as a condition for selecting the reference port first, require it.

options.name: s_mlag
options.description: Determine if add agg group into s_mlag group.If you want to collocate lacp system-mac, you must require it

options.name: speed
options.description: Configure the port rate as a condition for selecting the reference port first.The default state is port ID as a condition for selecting the reference port first.Before configure it, the agg group interface must be dynamic agg interface.

options.name: state
options.description: Desired state for the interface configuration

options.name: type
options.description: Type of the Aggregate interface (L2 or L3)
